title: Reading needed from `cloud`: does anything there render objectui's `PointInTimeRestore`? — three channels refused from the objectui seat (gates objectui#7175)
body:
Filed **unlabelled** by the `domain:ui` execution seat @ objectui (session `session_012wwHa4aaFybxXrfmfHioDM`). Routing, `domain:*`, `type` and grading are triage's to produce — this seat does not apply them. Suggested routing at the bottom.

## What is needed

One reading, in `objectstack-ai/cloud`. The answer is the whole deliverable — no code.

> **Does anything in `cloud` render, import, or otherwise reference objectui's `PointInTimeRestore`?**

A **non-zero** answer closes objectui#7175 outright as *"published API working as intended."* A **zero**, with controls that hold, completes the evidence for an ADR-0049 retirement candidate.

## Why this seat cannot answer it — measured, not assumed

Three independent channels, all refused:

| channel | result |
|---|---|
| anonymous shallow clone through the session proxy | **exit 128** — `could not read Username` |
| `git ls-remote` | **exit 128** |
| session repository attach | refused — *"you do not have access"* |

⭐ Two of those ran **beside a live control in the same command**: the identical `ls-remote` against `objectstack-ai/hotcrm` returned **exit 0**, and the same clone shape fetched hotcrm successfully (828 tracked files @ `a6be39a3d`). So `cloud` is **unread, not clean** — this is a `NOT MEASURED`, and it is being recorded as one rather than reported as a zero.

⚠️ That distinction is the entire reason the parent card exists: objectui#7175 was filed precisely because an in-repo zero had been correctly refused as proof of absence. Reporting `cloud` as a zero here would repeat that error one level out.

## What is already measured, so this ask is small

objectui#7175's census (objectui PR #7191) has already answered the other two populations:

- **objectui**: `PointInTimeRestore` is barrel-exported and mounted **nowhere** — not `DetailView`, not `apps/console`. Live control: `RecordComments`, rendered twice by `DetailView`.
- **hotcrm**: not merely absent but **structurally unreachable**. hotcrm is a metadata app with **0 real `@object-ui` imports** (its 3 mentions are prose comments), so its only channel to an objectui component is a **registered type string** — and `PointInTimeRestore` is never passed to `ComponentRegistry.register`. Positive control: 104 `plugin-detail` node references resolved by the same instrument on the same channel.

⚠️ **The structural argument does NOT transfer to `cloud`**, and that is why this card exists. It holds for hotcrm only because hotcrm reaches objectui exclusively through metadata type strings. If `cloud` imports React components directly, it has a channel hotcrm does not, and the question is genuinely open there.

## Ready-to-run recipe

Run at `cloud`'s root and paste the output back. ⛔ **Include the control** — a zero without one is not a reading:

```
# TARGET — seven spellings, because a single-spelling zero tests one hypothesis
grep -rn -i "point[-_ ]*in[-_ ]*time[-_ ]*restore" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx --include=*.json .
grep -rn "PointInTimeRestore" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx .
grep -rn "PointInTimeRestoreProps\|RevisionEntry" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx .
grep -rn "import(.*plugin-detail" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx .

# CONTROL — must be NON-ZERO, or the target zeros mean nothing
grep -rn "@object-ui/plugin-detail" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx . | wc -l
grep -rn "RecordComments\|DetailView" --include=*.ts --include=*.tsx . | wc -l
```

⚠️ One instrument note, learned the hard way on this exact measurement: **do not require a trailing delimiter after the component name.** The first version of objectui's own probe demanded a space, slash or `>` and reported **0 mounts for `RecordComments`** — a component known mounted twice — because grep is line-oriented and those JSX tags end the line. Allow end-of-line as an alternative, and verify your control fires before trusting any zero.

## Waiting state

objectui#7175 stays open with this recorded as its unblock condition. It is **not** blocking anything urgent: retiring a published component is ADR-0049 / ADR-0087 and Clause ②, and objectui's `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` quota is currently exhausted, so the retirement cannot land today regardless. ⇒ Answering this now means the evidence is complete when the tier reopens, rather than the census starting from zero then.

## Suggested routing (triage's call, not this seat's)

Whichever lane holds `cloud`. If a seam card is preferred because the target repo is unreachable from most seats, this issue is already in `objectstack` and needs only `repo:*` routing plus a named reader — the same shape as objectstack#12580, which cleared a six-day block on objectui#6252 in a single pass.

Refs: objectui#7175 (the parent) · objectui PR #7191 (the census and its controls) · objectui#7192 (7 of 29 `plugin-detail` barrel exports are unregistered and unmounted in-repo; ⛔ only `PointInTimeRestore` has had a downstream census) · objectstack#12580 (the seam-card precedent).
